tailoring.headline: Senior Business Processes Consultant – Direct-to-Consumer E-Commerce (SAP Commerce Cloud)
tailoring.summary: Backend specialist with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in business process design, PIM/ERP data integration, API development (OCC/REST) and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration. Proven record of translating business requirements into scalable e-commerce platforms, driving continuous improvement and supporting production in global environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: (Senior) Manager Business Processes Direct-to-Consumer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Puma’s ambition to shape a seamless direct-to-consumer experience. With over five years building SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep e-commerce expertise with a proven ability to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.

bullets.label: **Process Design**
bullets.text: At Rockwell I designed end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and defined functional specifications that streamlined product catalog management across global channels.

bullets.label: **Tech Partnership**
bullets.text: I partnered with international tech teams to migrate OCC APIs and integrate SAP ERP and MDM systems, ensuring reliable data flow for e-commerce operations.

bullets.label: **Stakeholder Management**
bullets.text: My techno-functional role involved gathering requirements, writing user stories and facilitating UAT with business owners, delivering solutions that met both functional and performance targets.

bullets.label: **Delivery & Support**
bullets.text: I led CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, optimized database queries and provided production hyper-care, guaranteeing high availability during peak sales periods.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Puma’s heritage of sport performance and its bold move toward a direct-to-consumer digital model resonates with my passion for creating high-impact e-commerce experiences. I want to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to accelerate Puma’s fashion process template, enhance integration between PIM, ERP and storefronts, and help the brand deliver a seamless, data-driven shopping journey for athletes worldwide.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Puma build a best-in-class direct-to-consumer e-commerce platform, leveraging my SAP Commerce and integration experience to drive fast, reliable digital experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years in e-commerce integration. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Puma’s direct-to-consumer initiatives. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize Puma’s e-commerce backend by implementing OCC APIs and optimizing PIM-ERP data pipelines, drawing on my recent work at Rockwell Automation. I will also provide production hyper-care to ensure a smooth launch of new direct-to-consumer features.
tailoring.insight: Puma’s focus on a fashion process template for direct-to-consumer e-commerce aligns with my experience designing scalable process flows and integrating PIM/ERP data, enabling rapid rollout and continuous improvement.
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer based in Karlsruhe. Puma’s drive to enhance its direct-to-consumer e-commerce platform excites me, and my 5+ years delivering integrated SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell match this vision. I can accelerate your fashion process template, improve PIM-ERP integration and ensure robust production support. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
